name: Cover Card to Fixed Header
description: A full-viewport cover hero that shrinks, darkens and docks into a fixed page header as you scroll, driven entirely by the native CSS animation-timeline: scroll() function with zero JavaScript.
usage: Include styles.css, make your hero a <header class="cvh-cover"> containing a .cvh-cover-inner with an h1.cvh-title and an optional p.cvh-sub tagline, then wrap everything that follows in <main class="cvh-content">. The cover collapses from 100vh to a fixed 10vh header over the first 90vh of scroll; tune the docked height via --cvh-docked on .cvh-cover.
